question: how to auto post youtube shorts
response_text:
Hello! As a content creator in the US, automating your YouTube Shorts workflow is one of the most effective ways to scale your channel without burning out. "Auto-posting" in this context usually involves two stages: **automated generation/editing** (turning long-form content into shorts) and **automated publishing** (scheduling the upload).

Here’s a breakdown of the best software tools, workflow methods, and industry options to streamline this process.

### 1. Best Software Tools for Automation & Editing

#### **A. Auto-Clip Creation (Long-Form → Shorts)**
These tools use AI to identify the most engaging moments in your long videos and automatically cut, caption, and resize them into vertical Shorts.
